verdict.rationale: The evidence documents headless execution of the real engine: Player headless mode, Editor command-line automation, -batchmode/-nographics for headless CI builds, and a CLI plus Build Automation aimed at CI pipelines. Nothing in the pack shows a test framework or a documented way to run unit or integration tests of game code in that headless CI context, so the core 'tests' element is only implied. Missing for 10: a documented test runner (e.g. command-line test execution with result reporting), evidence that unit and integration tests run headlessly in CI, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
